subject: 市场摊棚
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single RGBA building sprite for a realistic historical Chinese isometric town map. Year 1223 CE, Southern Song Lin'an/Jiangnan. Render realistic weathered wood, handmade grey tiles, natural stone and plaster, muted warm earthy tones, sophisticated historical game environment, not cartoon. Camera MUST be exact orthographic yaw 45 degrees, elevation pitch 30 degrees; 2:1 diamond ground grid with ground edges at slopes +0.5 and -0.5; no perspective convergence. Local south-facing entrance appears on screen lower-left facing wall. Single isolated complete building module over a thin flat rectangular ground footprint, no thick diorama plinth, ground footprint edges clearly visible. Main light comes from screen upper left, short soft contact shadow toward lower right only. True transparent background alpha; no white background, no checkerboard texture, no sky or surroundings. Center entire silhouette with minimum 10 percent transparent margin on EVERY side. Full eaves and base within image. No people, no characters, no readable writing, no signage text, no watermark, no modern objects, no Qing/Ming palace fashions, no excessive fantasy curls. Footprint dimensions relate to planning ground, not total roof height. Footprint exactly 3 by 2 one-metre cells. Ground edge running down-right (left corner to front corner) is 3 units and edge running up-right (front corner to right corner) is 2 units. Therefore their horizontal lengths ratio MUST be 1.5000, both slopes exactly 0.5. Subject: One small Southern Song Lin'an market stall, four rough wooden posts holding a plain tan linen pitched canopy, single counter along the southwest-facing side, baskets of vegetables, folded cloth and a few ceramic jars, thin rectangular paving footprint, no roofed building behind it.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。
created_time_basis: copy2保留的源PNG文件mtime；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 首版已 view_image original：完整历史木构单体，主入口左下，无文字人物现代物，左上光源。预览背景RGB光晕经PIL实测为alpha=0，非实心背景。保留首版沉稳色彩。底面边线及占地比例存在残差，精确量点由 root 复核，不声称严格通过。
